title: Ruleset: partner_moves
description: rules/<id>/partner_moves.yaml: the moves the partner equips when it starts and when it is reborn (packages/session: PartnerMoveRules, docs/modulos/apps/session.md). A position is an index in the species' move list (data/digimon: moves).

new_game_slot.description: The position of the first technique of the new game's partner, which it also learns.

new_game_species_slots.description: The species whose new-game partner equips and learns another position than new_game_slot, by species id.

reborn_slot.description: The position of the only move a reborn partner equips; it keeps the learned ones.

quirks.description: The original's oddities (true reproduces them; ADR 0022).

forget_mask_16_bits.description: utils2.c: unlearnMove clears a move's learned bit through a 16-bit mask, so the upper sixteen moves of its word of 32 go with it; false forgets only that move.
